about_the_game:
"Stranger of Crystal City" Special Pack is an expansion for the base game Villages & Dungeons.

Players who own this DLC pack take on the role of a traveler from the distant land of Crystal City—a place famed for its abundant elemental crystals and the refined craftsmanship used to shape them.

This DLC includes the following content, unlocked upon entering the game:

Character Title:

  • Stranger of Crystal City

Character Skins:

  • Crystal Core Warrior (Male)

  • Crystal Scholar (Female)

In-Game Items:

  • Transparent Elemental Crystal ×300

  • Flame Elemental Crystal ×100

  • Frost Elemental Crystal ×100

  • Verdant Elemental Crystal ×100

  • Light Elemental Crystal ×100

  • Shadow Elemental Crystal ×100
